question_text: Let $A$ and $B$ represent the number of units produced of product A and product B, respectively, per day. Each unit of A requires $2$ tons of steel and $3$ hours of machining time. Each unit of B requires $4$ tons of steel and $1$ hour of machining time. The company has at most $100$ tons of steel and at most $60$ hours of machining time available daily. The constraints are $2A+4B \leq 100$ (steel) and $3A+B \leq 60$ (machining time). If the company must produce at least $5$ units of A, i.e., $A \geq 5$, what is the maximum possible value of $B$?
